summary: During the review cycle, both the medical review (MedR Part 8, section 8.5) and the clinical pharmacology review stated that an Advisory Committee meeting was to be held in September 2006 to address the benefit:risk of paliperidone (Pal) relative to already-marketed risperidone and safety signals such as QT prolongation and food effects. However, the final action package (Administrative Correspondence) records the Advisory Committee Meeting 'Date of Meeting' as 'Not applicable,' and no review document describes any meeting having actually taken place (no committee name, no vote, and no recommendation). Based on the available FDA documents, no advisory committee was convened for this approval, so no AC-to-change linkages can be established.
